review:
A Vegas-style 5x5 with fruit and golden bells on deep blue reels and real casino sounds.

The free spins build simply: collect four wilds for 10 more spins, and the multiplier goes up to 2x, then 3x, then 10x – the same escalation as Loki Loot and Big Boat Big Catch. Medium volatility, 5,000x max and a 97.2% RTP. Free spins about once every 177 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.20% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
